verdict.rationale: Supabase is a managed Postgres platform, so in-database analytics is a fair axis. The only relevant evidence is Read Replicas, documented for offloading reads (load balancing, latency), and Advisors that flag missing indexes; both help aggregation workloads only indirectly. missing for 10: any columnar/OLAP engine or analytics extension, materialized-view or pre-aggregation guidance, performance evidence for large-table aggregations at dashboard latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
